name: Sunrise Bank
greeting: Welcome to Sunrise Bank support. Tell me the error you are seeing.
support_hours: open 9 AM to 8 PM every day
_note: Fictional bank and invented error codes for demo purposes.

entries.title: UPI daily limit exceeded
entries.cause: You have reached the daily UPI limit on your account.
entries.fix: Try again after midnight, or raise the limit in the mobile app under Settings, then UPI limits.

entries.title: Card blocked for online use
entries.cause: Online transactions are switched off for this card by default.
entries.fix: Open the app, go to Card controls, and turn on online transactions.

entries.title: Netbanking login locked
entries.cause: Three wrong password attempts locked your netbanking access.
entries.fix: Use Forgot Password with your registered mobile number, or wait 24 hours for automatic unlock.

entries.title: Cheque deposit rejected
entries.cause: The cheque image was unclear or cut off.
entries.fix: Retake the photo on a dark flat surface with all four corners visible.

entries.title: KYC update pending
entries.cause: Your KYC documents are due for renewal, so some features are restricted.
entries.fix: Upload your documents in the app under Profile, then KYC, or visit any branch.
